name: Helene floods, western NC
note: Rain from Hurricane Helene sent western North Carolina rivers to their peaks on 27 September 2024 (28 September at Blantyre). At 7 of these 8 gauges the peak flow was the highest in the USGS annual-peak list for the gauge.
